description: This file contains a suite of unit tests for Orleans Timer functionality within the Orleans distributed application framework. It verifies timer behavior, lifecycle, concurrency, reactivity, and compatibility with grains and POCO grains through multiple test cases.

classes.name: TimerOrleansTest
classes.description: A comprehensive test class for Orleans Timer functionality, covering timer start/stop, parallel execution, deactivation, async callbacks, overloads, self-disposal, non-reentrant constraints, timer change methods, and POCO grain timer behaviors.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Basic
methods.description: Tests fundamental properties of timers: start, stop, expected ticks, and independence across grains.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Parallel
methods.description: Verifies timer behavior when multiple grains run timers in parallel, ensuring isolation.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Migration
methods.description: Tests timer persistence across grain deactivation and reactivation, confirming non-durability.

methods.name: AsyncTimerTest_GrainCall
methods.description: Checks that timer callbacks can perform async grain calls and exceptions are handled gracefully.

methods.name: GrainTimer_TestAllOverloads
methods.description: Verifies all overloads of timer registration methods function correctly and callbacks are executed.

methods.name: GrainTimer_DisposeFromCallback
methods.description: Ensures timers can safely self-dispose within their own callbacks without deadlocks or errors.

methods.name: NonReentrantGrainTimer_Test
methods.description: Validates that non-reentrant grains serialize timer callbacks according to concurrency constraints.

methods.name: GrainTimer_Change
methods.description: Tests dynamic modification of timer periods and due times, including edge cases and invalid inputs.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Basic_Poco
methods.description: Checks timer functionality with POCO grains to ensure independence from grain implementation style.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Parallel_Poco
methods.description: Verifies independent timer operation across multiple POCO grains.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Migration_Poco
methods.description: Tests timer lifecycle in POCO grains across deactivate/reactivate cycles.

methods.name: AsyncTimerTest_GrainCall_Poco
methods.description: Validates async grain calls from POCO grain timers with exception handling.

methods.name: GrainTimer_TestAllOverloads_Poco
methods.description: Checks all timer registration overloads on POCO grains for correctness and callback execution.

methods.name: NonReentrantGrainTimer_Test_Poco
methods.description: Verifies timer serialization behavior in non-reentrant POCO grains.

methods.name: GrainTimer_Change_Poco
methods.description: Tests runtime modifications of timers on POCO grains, including edge cases and invalid scenarios.
